Hyderabadi Biryani Commercial

Flow AI

Prompt Directives & How to Use

Ultra-photorealistic cinematic luxury food commercial featuring an ascending handi biryani bowl with volumetric steam, golden embers, and glowing 3D typography.

Directorial technique: Uses a dynamic vertigo dolly-zoom and volumetric steam to emphasize the luxury dish.

Recommended workflow

  1. Generate the video in Flow AI. This prompt is designed for Flow AI; other generators may interpret its camera and motion instructions differently.
  2. Prepare reference images separately. A source image is not required by this prompt. If you choose to use one, create it with an image tool and attach it in Flow AI only if supported.
  3. Personalize before generating. Replace bracketed placeholders, set the aspect ratio and duration in the video tool, then keep the scene, camera, and lighting directives together when you run it.
